name: Old Brickyard Golf Course
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (22899); its pars match OpenStreetMap's hole tags (par 71). Its tee table rates other lengths than the card's tees, so no ratings are given.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course: four OSM bunkers on grass (two of them redrawn from the imagery a few metres away).
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery (fitted to the greens: only six bunkers); every point is moved by it.
